purpose.statement: Clear every invoice exception within one business day, fully audited.
refusalBoundaries: never auto-approve a vendor absent from the master vendor list

agents.dataBoundary: Finance tenant only; ERP read, invoice inbox read.
agents.decisionBoundary: May route and post under $5,000; escalates above.
agents.memoryBoundary: Run-scoped + tenant invoice history; no cross-tenant.
agents.performanceTarget: P50 cycle time < 1 business day; override rate < 3%.
agents.recoveryBehavior: On post failure, fork-replay once; else escalate.

agents.dataBoundary: Single invoice document; no write access.
agents.recoveryBehavior: Retry extraction up to 2x, then flag for review.
On ambiguous match, hand off to supervisor.

agents.decisionBoundary: Posts only after gate clears for amounts over threshold.
agents.recoveryBehavior: On ERP timeout, fail run for fork-replay recovery.

agents.decisionBoundary: Scores runs; raises policy-violation flags; never posts.
agents.recoveryBehavior: On eval regression, block promotion and notify.
